app.name: Einbürgerungstest
app.tagline: Your path to the German citizenship test
mode.learn.desc: Work through a level, one question at a time
mode.speed.desc: 60 seconds, as many as you can
mode.reverse.desc: Match the fact to its question
dash.title: Dashboard
dash.readiness.title: Exam readiness
dash.readiness.empty: Answer a few questions to see your predicted score.
dash.readiness.explain: Estimated from your mastery of all 310 questions, weighted like the real exam: 30 federal questions and 3 from {state}.
dash.heatmap.title: All 310 questions
dash.heatmap.hint: Tap any cell to practise that question
dash.categories.title: Topic strength
dash.nemesis.title: Nemesis questions
dash.nemesis.empty: Nothing here yet. That is a good thing.
dash.flagged.title: Flagged
dash.flagged.empty: No flagged questions yet. Tap the star on any question to save it here.
dash.streak.title: Practice streak
dash.history.title: Mock exam history
dash.timeToReady.title: Estimated time to ready
worlds.title: Worlds
worlds.subtitle: {cleared} of {total} levels cleared
worlds.unlockHint: Clear {percent}% of the previous level to unlock this one.
worlds.nudge: This one is not unlocked yet, but you can try it if you like.
level.title: Level {name}
q.recallPrompt: Answer in your head first, then show the options.
hint.1.title: A nudge
hint.2.title: Eliminate two options
hint.3.title: Show the answer
hint.noMastery: Using a hint means this question will not count as mastered.
fb.requeue: Ask me this again in 3 questions
fb.requeued: We'll come back to this one.
feynman.title: Quick reversal
feynman.prompt: Which question does this fact answer?
session.quit.confirm: End this session? Your answers so far are saved.
done.title: Session complete
done.notCleared: Not cleared yet — you need {percent}% to clear this level.
drill.title: Drill
drill.subtitle: The ones you need most
drill.empty: Nothing due for review. Play a level first.
mock.title: Mock exam
mock.intro.title: Real exam conditions
mock.intro.germanOnly: German only, like the real thing.
mock.submit.confirm: Submit your exam? {count} questions are unanswered.
mock.review.title: Exam review
mock.translationsUnlocked: Translations are available in this review.
speed.title: Speed round
speed.intro: 60 seconds. Options are always visible. Keep the streak alive.
set.title: Settings
set.interfaceLanguage.desc: The language of buttons, menus and labels.
set.translationLanguage.desc: Translations of question text, answers and explanations. Independent of the interface language.
set.alwaysShowTranslation.desc: Show the translation immediately instead of hiding it until you answer.
set.mockTranslations.desc: The real exam is German only. Turning this on makes your predicted score less predictive.
set.recallFirst.desc: Hide the answer options until you tap Show options.
set.tts.unavailable: Your browser does not offer a German voice.
set.storage.title: Storage
set.storage.persisted: Your progress is protected from automatic cleanup.
set.storage.notPersisted: Your browser may clear your progress if storage runs low. Export a backup to be safe.
set.storage.unsupported: This browser does not report storage protection.
set.export.desc: Download a backup file you can keep anywhere.
set.import.desc: Restore from a backup file. Your current progress is merged, never replaced.
set.import.invalid: That file is not a valid backup.
set.snapshots.title: Snapshots
set.snapshots.desc: The last 10 automatic saves, in case something goes wrong.
set.reset.desc: Deletes every answer, star and note on this device.
set.reset.confirm: Delete all your progress? This cannot be undone.
sync.desc: Optional. Sign in to keep your progress on all your devices.
sync.uploadNotice: Signing in uploads the progress already on this device — your answers, flagged questions and any notes you have written.
sync.notConfigured: Sync is not set up for this copy of the app. Everything else works normally, and your progress is saved on this device.
sync.merged: Your progress on this device was merged with your account.
sync.error.detail: We could not reach the sync service. Your progress is safe on this device and will upload when you are back online.
badge.title: Badges
badge.worldCleared.desc: Cleared every level in a world
err.title: Something went wrong
err.generic: Something went wrong. Your progress is safe.
err.notFound.title: Page not found
err.loadQuestions: We could not load the questions. Check your connection and try again.
err.loadTranslation: That translation could not be loaded. Showing German instead.
err.offline: You are offline. Practice still works.
pwa.installable: Add this app to your home screen for offline practice.
onb.notPermanent: You can change all of this later in Settings. Nothing here is permanent.
onb.welcome.title: Let's get you ready
onb.welcome.body: 300 general questions plus 10 about your Bundesland. The real exam asks 33; you need 17 right to pass.
onb.state.title: Which Bundesland do you live in?
onb.state.desc: Your exam includes 10 questions about this state. You can switch later without losing any progress.
onb.ui.title: What language should the app use?
onb.ui.desc: This changes the buttons and menus, not the exam questions.
onb.translation.title: Would you like the questions translated?
onb.translation.desc: The exam is in German only, so the German text always stays visible. A translation is shown next to it to help you understand.
onb.sync.title: Study on more than one device?
onb.sync.desc: Sign in with Google and your progress follows you to your phone, tablet and laptop. Skip this and everything still works — your progress is saved on this device.
onb.sync.signedIn: Signed in as {account}. Your progress will sync automatically from now on.
onb.sync.error: Sign-in did not work. You can try again from Settings at any time.
state.label: Bundesland
state.switch.note: Your progress on the 300 general questions carries over. Your progress in {previous} is kept in case you switch back.
state.reset.state.desc: Clears your progress on this state's 10 questions. Your progress on the 300 general questions is not touched.
drill.scope.due.desc: Questions you are about to forget, according to your review schedule.
drill.scope.nemesis.desc: The questions you get wrong most often.
drill.scope.flagged.desc: Questions you marked to come back to.
set.reset.cloudFailed: Your progress on this device was deleted, but the copy in your account could not be reached. Sign in again and retry.
set.reset.otherDevices: If you are signed in on another device, that device may upload its copy again. Reset it there too, or sign out there first.
about.disclaimer: An independent, unofficial study aid. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to the BAMF or any German authority.
about.source: The questions come from the official BAMF catalogue “Gesamtfragenkatalog Leben in Deutschland”. Only that catalogue and the responsible authority are binding.
sync.signOut.keep.desc: Your progress stays on this device and in your account.
sync.signOut.wipe: Sign out and remove from this device
sync.signOut.wipe.desc: Your progress stays safely in your account and is deleted from this device. Use this on a shared or borrowed computer.
sync.signOut.wiped: Signed out. Your progress was removed from this device and is safe in your account.
sync.accountSwitched: This device held another account's progress. It was saved as a backup below, and your own progress has been loaded.
sync.sessionEnded: You were signed out. This can happen if you signed out on another device or removed this app's access to your Google account.
set.deleteAccount.desc: Removes your account and everything in it, both here and in the cloud.
set.deleteAccount.confirm: Delete your account and all your progress? This cannot be undone.
set.deleteAccount.reauth: Google will ask you to confirm it is you.
set.deleteAccount.done: Your account and all your progress have been deleted.
set.deleteAccount.failed: Your account could not be fully deleted. Your progress on this device was kept so you do not lose it. Please try again.
set.deleteAccount.cancelled: Your progress in the cloud was deleted, but the account itself still exists. Choose delete again to finish.
